title: Maximum Product Subarray

monster.name: Sign-Flipping Fiend
monster.title: Lord of Inverted Negatives
monster.defeatQuote: Tracking both max and min products neutralized my parity flips!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, find a subarray that has the largest product, and return the product.
hints: Track current maximum and minimum product at each step since multiplying by a negative swaps them.
